answer: Each new identity must lock a prism-split bond at its admission vertex: capital is divided into independently auditable escrow shards. Peers only countersign after verifying that no shard-funding or key material collides with an existing identity inside a nebula of established co-attestors. If a collision or double-use is proven, every shard is burned and a residual slash hits the co-attestors who signed that vertex, so a farm pays full bonded capital per fake and cannot reuse one wallet cheaply.
